O.outcome_detail: basic bronchoscopy skills assessed in simulation

cells.quote: This systematic review shows that flexible bronchoscopy simulation-based training is effective in improving skills when evaluated in a simulation setting.
cells.note: The review included pretest-posttest, two-group nonrandomized, and randomized studies; no pooled effect size was calculated because of heterogeneity.

O.outcome_detail: bronchoscopy performance in patients, including BSTAT and procedure time

cells.quote: Four studies measured Kirkpatrick (behavioral) level 3 outcomes (eg, BSTAT for a bronchoscopy performed on a patient).
cells.note: The review states that evidence in the patient setting was sparse and inconsistent: only two of four studies reported significant improvements in (modified) BSTAT outcomes, and procedure-time effects were conflicting.

O.outcome_detail: bronchoscopy performance in a patient setting

cells.quote: When evaluating the study characteristics of the studies with the highest quality (mMERSQI > 12) and positive results on the most relevant outcome measures (higher than Kirkpatrick level 2), we found that these studies30,33 shared the following characteristics: a gradual increase in task difficulty and integration of the TP in the curriculum.
cells.note: This is an instructional-feature comparison inferred from study characteristics, not a pooled or randomized factorial estimate.

O.outcome_detail: (modified) BSTAT performance during bronchoscopy in patients

cells.quote: Two of four studies with outcomes on Kirkpatrick level 3 reported significant improvements in (modified) BSTAT outcomes.
cells.note: The four patient-setting studies used heterogeneous comparators; two reported significant BSTAT improvement and the review did not provide a pooled effect size.

O.outcome_detail: procedure time during bronchoscopy in patients

cells.quote: Ost et al,28 Blum et al,29 and Siow et al30 all reported procedure time outcomes in a patient setting. However, their effect on procedure time was conflicting.
cells.note: The review reports conflicting procedure-time effects across the three patient-setting studies and provides no pooled effect size.
